info.title: FreeKiosk REST API
info.description:
The REST API of the FreeKiosk Android app: read the state of a tablet and control it over the local network.

Turn it on in **Settings > Advanced > REST API** (or over ADB). The default port is 8080. The server stays reachable while the screen is off.

**Authentication.** Optional. When an API key is set on the tablet, send it as the `X-Api-Key` header, or as the password of an HTTP Basic credential (any user name), for clients such as the Home Assistant MJPEG camera integration that can only send Basic. Without a key, no credential is asked.

**Answers.** JSON: `{ "success": true, "data": {...}, "timestamp": 1704672000 }`, or `{ "success": false, "error": "...", "timestamp": ... }` with a 4xx or 5xx status. Screenshots and camera pictures are binary images.

**Remote control.** The commands answer 403 when **Allow remote control** is off in the settings; the read endpoints do not. Some commands need Device Owner (reboot, lock, true screen off).

Read endpoints and most commands accept GET and POST, for convenience. Commands that need values take a JSON body on POST only.

This file is checked against the routes of the server by the test suite (`__tests__/OpenApiSpec.test.ts`), so a route added or removed without updating it fails the build. The guide with examples is [docs/rest-api.md](rest-api.md).

ApiKeyBasic.description: The API key is the password; the user name is ignored

Unauthorized.description: The API key is set on the tablet and the request does not carry it

Forbidden.description: Remote control is switched off in the settings (REST API > Allow remote control)

BadRequest.description: A required value is missing or invalid; `error` says which

Unavailable.description: The feature is not available right now (for example the camera permission is not granted); `error` says why

MethodNotAllowed.description: Only POST with a JSON body is accepted on this endpoint (a GET gets this answer)

CommandResult.description: What the app answers once it has run a command. Extra fields depend on the command.

executed.description: Whether the command was carried out

on.description: Physical screen state (PowerManager.isInteractive); true while the screensaver overlay shows

screensaverActive.description: Whether the screensaver overlay is covering the content

light.description: Lux; -1 when there is no sensor

isDeviceOwner.description: Required for reboot, lock and a true screen off

kioskMode.description: Whether lock task mode is active

Location.description: Last known position (GPS, network and passive providers). Needs the location permission and location switched on.
